name: Sherpur

queries.query: Sherpur Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Sherpur district portal, the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) online map-search service, and the government Mouza/Plot land-zoning map portal. These establish official land-map routes, but no city-bounded anonymous parcel feature response was found.

queries.query: শেরপুর বাংলাদেশ সরকারি খতিয়ান মৌজা ম্যাপ ভূমি রেকর্ড GIS
queries.result: সরকারি ফলাফলে শেরপুর জেলা পোর্টালের ভূমি-সংক্রান্ত সেবা এবং DLRS-এর ম্যাপ অনুসন্ধান/মৌজা ম্যাপ সেবা পাওয়া গেছে। শেরপুরের জন্য বেনামী, শহর-সীমাবদ্ধ পার্সেল জ্যামিতি বা স্থিতিশীল নিরাপদ পার্সেল আইডির প্রকাশ্য প্রতিক্রিয়া পাওয়া যায়নি।

officialSources.operator: Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys
officialSources.observation: Official public map-search viewer exposing division, district, survey, upazila, mouza, sheet, and dag selectors. Sherpur district was returned in the district list, but its survey-list request returned an empty JSON array; no parcel geometry was returned.

officialSources.operator: Bangladesh government Mouza and Plot Based National Digital Land Zoning Project
officialSources.observation: Official viewer JavaScript exposed anonymous administrative and geometry routes and a GeoServer WMS configuration. The live division list returned seven divisions and did not include Mymensingh, the division containing Sherpur; no Sherpur parcel request was therefore executed through this route.

Official local district portal with land-related services and links, including land-office and khas/government-land material. It does not publish an anonymous parcel geometry layer or stable parcel identity API.

officialSources.operator: Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys
officialSources.observation: Official integrated online map-purchase portal describing CS, SA, RS, BRS, and BDS Mouza-map products. It is a map-order/catalog route, not an anonymous geometry API, and no order or formal request was submitted.

registryBasis: Official DLRS and Sherpur District Administration pages establish Bangladesh's land-record/map custodian and a local district land-service route. This is custodian/procedure evidence only; it does not establish an open Sherpur city parcel adapter.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Bangladesh land-record, Mouza-map, survey-map, and land-zoning services; Sherpur district is present in the DLRS selector route.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous Sherpur city parcel feature, native parcel identity, parcel schema, or CRS was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: Sherpur coverage may exist in restricted, order-based, unavailable, or not-yet-published survey data. Empty selector/API responses, a map extent miss, service unavailability, or no exact-point hit do not establish citywide absence. No WUP coordinate was shifted.
identityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; do not synthesize an identity from response order, selector values, or internal records.
